initial_negative_evidence.preserved_sources: Compact .initial.gz files and fixture-shape-repair test snapshot; no production files replaced by reviewer.
initial_negative_evidence.fixture_setup_truth: Earlier initial-check had three intended lifecycle checks blocked by stale fixture source/group metadata. Copied constructed helper shape corrected only; those earlier setup failures are not claimed as independent production findings.

repairs_reviewed: Numerical evidence binds executing helper origins/hashes and actual per-run runtime/executable/command/cwd/output receipts. All20 bound primitive sets are independently reread before freezing; rebuilt numerical groups must exactly equal supplied report. Claimed passing booleans, arbitrary units/limits or dummy JSON blobs do not authorize disclosure.

Readout computes numerical comparisons under fixed protocol rules, including mesh/step/scale and two fitted confirmations; exact raw-file inventory is sealed after replay and reverified before torque access.

Source release binds actual Git-source tar bytes and PAX commit identity, plus each expected executing source member. Historical preparation source is bound separately from current fitted-deck builder; runner-level historical preparation record verification remains part of experiment review.
CSV interpretation and ledger location are release-bound. Only exact selected ZIP members are read; changed archive bytes and duplicate names reject before payload access.

A durable freeze_saved event binds exact freeze path/hash. Altered/rehashed prediction+freeze cannot replace it. Calibration and refreezing close after saved freeze, and held_out_attempt closes them even when parsing fails; restart or fresh ledger path does not reset that state.

Per-run successful int exit status, elapsed cap, runtime identity, executable, command and working directory are checked. Constructed wrong-cwd control confirms identical command text cannot attach to a different folder.
Final readout retains nonpositive logged-J rejection and uses the exact existing deck residual-floor arithmetic for arbitrary fitted modulus, with unchanged tolerance.

test_isolation.lifecycle_controls: Owner analytical_prerequisite_stubs replaces actual release provenance and complete numerical replay solely to exercise ledger/freeze/ZIP behavior. These tests do not establish authentic20-run fidelity.
test_isolation.unmocked_rejection_controls: Real validators reject dummy source/numerical proof and changed archive. Tar-member corruption runs real tar/path/hash code with a constructed module-origin path.
test_isolation.isolated_replay_comparison: Only source-origin prerequisite and replay producer are stubbed to compare a known rebuilt report against an altered rehashed claim; this tests exact comparison separately from raw physics/replay.
test_isolation.cwd_control: Only expected runtime identity constant is set to constructed runtime digest. verify_run_execution, path checks and hashes run normally; constructed executable is never run.
test_isolation.readout_controls: Closed-form61-frame primitive fixtures and small comparison arrays exercise real parsing/physics/readout; no FEM execution.

remaining_requirements: Root must commit/freeze the complete source and separately release actual experiment access; passing these checks grants no measurement authorization.

The orchestrator and real release must bind preserved historical preparation, current builder, actual runtime/control receipts, numerical resource caps and the exact completed-run evidence. Independent orchestrator review is separate.

Actual20-run positive replay, real CSV schema validation, numerical convergence and empirical torsion agreement have not been performed here. Genuine measurements may fail and must remain failures without baseline tuning.
The ledger is a reproducibility/accidental-drift boundary, not security against an authorized host rewriting all history.
No donor transfer, patient material, clinical force/retraction/cutting or patient-accuracy claim follows from these constructed tests.
